SnippetSetResult.description: Resolved snippets of one language, merged with the language fallback chain.

languageId.description: Id of the language the snippets were resolved for.

locale.description: Locale of the resolved snippet set, e.g. `de-DE`.

fallbackLocale.description: Fallback locale prefix used while resolving, e.g. `de`. Null if it equals the locale.

snippetSetId.description: Id of the snippet set the database overrides were taken from.

hash.description: Content hash of the `snippets` map. Also sent as `ETag` response header, so clients can revalidate cheaply via `If-None-Match`.

snippets.description: Flat map of fully resolved snippets, e.g. `{"account.loginTitle": "Log in"}`. Values are never null, the language fallback is already merged. Note: when no snippet matches the requested `prefixes`, the empty map is serialized as an empty JSON list (`[]`).

get.description:
Returns the fully resolved snippets (translations) for the authenticated sales channel as a flat key-value map. The language is taken from the `sw-language-id` header, the snippet set is resolved via the sales channel domains with a fallback to the locale of the language. The language fallback chain is already merged server-side, so values are never null.

The response carries an `ETag` header; send it back via `If-None-Match` to receive a `304 Not Modified` without a body when nothing changed.

Experimental API, not part of our backwards compatibility promise, thus this API can introduce breaking changes at any time.

parameters.name: prefixes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of namespace prefixes to limit the result, e.g. `checkout,account.login`. Prefixes match whole key segments, a trailing dot is optional: `checkout` matches `checkout.cart.title` but not `checkoutConfirm.title`. At most 50 distinct prefixes are allowed per request.

parameters.name: languageIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of language ids to fetch multiple languages in one request. Every id must be assigned to the sales channel. Defaults to the context language of the `sw-language-id` header.

200.description: The resolved snippets as a list of sets, one per language. Contains a single set for the context language unless `languageIds` requests more.

304.description: Not modified. Returned when the `If-None-Match` request header matches the current `ETag`.
